metadata.technology_specification: Active digital night vision goggles with infrared (IR) illuminator
metadata.technology_reasoning: Digital night vision goggles with infrared illumination are the most common type used by military, law enforcement, and civilians because they provide clear imaging in total darkness and are widely adopted due to improved sensor and processing technology since 2020, dominating over legacy image intensifier tube-based models.

components.reasoning: Core component that detects IR and low-light signals converting them to digital images; universally present in digital night vision goggles.
Provides active IR illumination enabling vision in total darkness; a key subassembly typically integrated but often procured separately.
Displays the processed night vision image to the user; exists as a distinct module in all digital night vision goggles.
Focuses incoming light and IR onto the sensor; a critical optical subassembly usually separately sourced.
Processes raw sensor data into viewable images, essential electronic subassembly.
Provides energy to all electronic components; typically a separate, rechargeable battery unit.
Protective and ergonomic casing that integrates all components, a standard separate mechanical assembly.
Includes switches, buttons, and adjustments for operation, common as a discrete subassembly but may vary in design.

Image Sensor Module (CMOS or CCD).name: Silicon
Image Sensor Module (CMOS or CCD).reasoning: Silicon is the fundamental semiconductor material forming the photosensitive array in CMOS and CCD sensors, absolutely essential for sensor function with no commercial alternatives.

Image Sensor Module (CMOS or CCD).name: Copper
Image Sensor Module (CMOS or CCD).reasoning: Copper is widely used for electrical interconnections and wiring within the image sensor module due to its excellent electrical conductivity and cost-effectiveness.

Image Sensor Module (CMOS or CCD).name: Aluminum
Image Sensor Module (CMOS or CCD).reasoning: Aluminum is commonly used in metallization layers and as a packaging or heat dissipating material, standard though sometimes substituted by other metals.

Image Sensor Module (CMOS or CCD).name: Glass
Image Sensor Module (CMOS or CCD).reasoning: Glass is used as the protective cover and encapsulation layer for the sensor array providing optical clarity and mechanical protection, industry standard.

Infrared (IR) Illuminator.name: Gallium arsenide
Infrared (IR) Illuminator.reasoning: Gallium arsenide is the primary semiconductor material for infrared LED or laser diode emitters in IR illuminators, absolutely essential for IR emission.

Infrared (IR) Illuminator.name: Aluminum
Infrared (IR) Illuminator.reasoning: Aluminum may be used as a heat sink or reflector material to manage thermal properties and enhance illumination, common but alternatives like copper or plastic exist.

Infrared (IR) Illuminator.name: Glass
Infrared (IR) Illuminator.reasoning: Glass is typically used for protective lenses and encapsulation around the IR diode to allow IR transmission and physical protection.

Display Module (OLED or LCD microdisplay.name: Indium
Display Module (OLED or LCD microdisplay.reasoning: Indium is a key raw material in indium tin oxide used for transparent electrodes in displays, industry standard though some emerging alternatives exist.

Display Module (OLED or LCD microdisplay.name: Aluminum
Display Module (OLED or LCD microdisplay.reasoning: Aluminum is used as an electrode or reflective layer in displays, common but sometimes substituted by silver or other metals.

Optical Lens Assembly.name: Aluminum
Optical Lens Assembly.reasoning: Aluminum is commonly used for lens housing and mechanical components due to its light weight and machinability, standard though some plastics can substitute.

Image Processing Unit (Digital Signal Pr.name: Glass

Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.name: Lithium

Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.name: Cobalt
Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.reasoning: Cobalt is used in many lithium-ion battery cathodes to enhance energy density and longevity, commonly used but alternatives such as manganese or iron phosphates exist (not in list).

Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.name: Nickel
Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.reasoning: Nickel is employed in cathode materials in many battery chemistries but is moderately substitutable and not listed here explicitly.

Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.name: Copper
Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.reasoning: Copper is essential for current collectors and electrical conductors inside battery packs, universal use.

Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.name: Aluminum
Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.reasoning: Aluminum often serves as the cathode current collector and external casing material, industry standard though some designs use steel.

Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.name: Graphite
Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Batter.reasoning: Graphite is the common anode material in lithium-ion batteries for lithium intercalation, absolutely essential.
